sourcePolicy: Newest usable matched DATA/WAL restore set; shared source preserved
diskLayout: separate DATA and WAL per primary/replica

difference.sigterm: One SIGTERM to verified replica walreceiver at actual VACUUM SQL start plus 600 seconds
difference.control: Timestamped no-signal observation at the same offset

endCondition: VACUUM exits successfully, replica replays final target, client recovers, minimum observation completes
hypothesis: A receiver disconnect during VACUUM might cause all client writes to hang for more than two hours; outcome is measured, not assumed
publication: Copy reviewed anonymized sources/results into local GitHub checkout; do not stage, commit or push
restoreMethod: Caller CLI exact-source DATA/WAL disk copy; static PV binding; no source grants or locks changed

walArchive.verification: independent cloud object download and safe temporary-path restore with byte hashes before measurement
walArchive.reason: Pilot prep removed archive references and did not test archive-based recovery

imageVariantReason: Barman Cloud binaries required for verified WAL archive/restore; both lanes use the same pinned PG16.15 system image
